2026-09-01.content:
Support for the [Go 1.27 runtime](https://docs.cloud.google.com/appengine/docs/standard/go/runtime) is in
[General Availability (GA)](https://cloud.google.com/products/#product-launch-stages).

summary.title: Go 1.27 runtime now available
summary.summary: The Go 1.27 runtime is now in General Availability (GA). This new runtime offers improved performance and features for your Go applications.

summary.title: Go 1.27 runtime support now in preview
summary.summary: The Go 1.27 runtime is now available in preview for App Engine standard environment. This new runtime offers improved performance and security features for your Go applications.

2026-08-19.content:
Starting from Go runtime version 1.26 and later, the lifecycle support dates
align more closely with the
[Go community release cycle](https://go.dev/wiki/Go-Release-Cycle). For more
information, see
[Runtime support schedule](https://docs.cloud.google.com/appengine/docs/standard/lifecycle/support-schedule#go).

summary.title: Go runtime lifecycle updates
summary.summary: Go runtime versions 1.26 and later now follow the Go community release cycle for lifecycle support. This change aligns the support dates more closely with the official Go releases, ensuring greater consistency. For detailed information on the updated support schedule, please refer to the runtime support documentation.

2026-08-19.content:
You can migrate your App Engine push queues to Cloud Tasks by updating the
bundled services SDK. This method lets you upgrade your app without needing to
modify your application code. For more information on how to migrate, see the
[push queues migration guide](https://docs.cloud.google.com/appengine/migration-center/standard/go/migrating-push-queues-upgrade-sdk)
([Preview](https://cloud.google.com/products/#product-launch-stages)).

summary.title: Migrate App Engine push queues to Cloud Tasks
summary.summary: You can now migrate your App Engine push queues to Cloud Tasks by updating the bundled services SDK. This upgrade allows you to move your queues without modifying your application code. Detailed migration instructions are available in the push queues migration guide.

2026-08-14.content: To improve security, starting in August 2026, App Engine opts your application into TLS version 1.2 and later. You can opt out until the end of August 2026. Starting in September 2026, App Engine might permanently block insecure traffic with TLS version 1.1 and earlier. For more information, see [Secure minimum TLS](https://docs.cloud.google.com/appengine/docs/standard/secure-minimum-tls).

summary.title: App Engine TLS Update
summary.summary: Starting August 2026, App Engine will default to TLS 1.2 and later for enhanced security. You can opt out until the end of August 2026, after which older TLS versions may be blocked.

2026-07-29.content:
Support for enabling only needed legacy bundled services using the
[`app_engine_bundled_services`](https://docs.cloud.google.com/appengine/docs/standard/reference/app-yaml?tab=go#app_engine_bundled_services)
field is in [General Availability](https://cloud.google.com/products/#product-launch-stages).

summary.title: Control legacy bundled services
summary.summary: You can now selectively enable legacy bundled services for your App Engine applications. Use the app_engine_bundled_services field in your app.yaml file to specify only the services you need. This feature is now in General Availability.

2026-06-03.content: App Engine supports [Direct VPC egress](https://docs.cloud.google.com/appengine/docs/standard/vpc-direct-vpc) in [Preview](https://cloud.google.com/products#product-launch-stages). Direct VPC egress lets your workloads access VPC network resources as a simpler, more cost-effective [alternative to Serverless VPC Access connectors](https://docs.cloud.google.com/appengine/docs/standard/compare-direct-vpc-egress-connectors).

summary.title: App Engine Direct VPC Egress in Preview
summary.summary: App Engine now supports Direct VPC egress in preview. This feature allows your workloads to access VPC network resources, offering a simpler and more cost-effective alternative to Serverless VPC Access connectors.

2026-05-27.content: Enable only needed legacy bundled services using the [`app_engine_bundled_services`](https://docs.cloud.google.com/appengine/docs/standard/reference/app-yaml?tab=go#app_engine_bundled_services) field for improved security and maintainability of your applications ([Preview](https://cloud.google.com/products/#product-launch-stages)).

summary.title: Control Legacy Bundled Services
summary.summary: You can now enable only the legacy bundled services that your application needs using the `app_engine_bundled_services` field. This improves security and maintainability. This feature is currently in Preview.

2026-05-21.content: The App Engine Migration hub lets you migrate services in the App Engine standard environment to Cloud Run, and also provides cost-saving recommendations. For more information, see [Deploy an App Engine app in the standard environment to Cloud Run](https://docs.cloud.google.com/appengine/migration-center/run/migrate-app-engine-standard-to-run) ([Preview](https://cloud.google.com/products?e=48754805#product-launch-stages)).

summary.title: Migrate App Engine to Cloud Run
summary.summary: App Engine Migration hub now allows you to migrate services from the App Engine standard environment to Cloud Run. This feature also offers recommendations for cost savings.

summary.title: Go 1.26 Runtime Now Generally Available
summary.summary: The Go 1.26 runtime is now in General Availability. This update brings the latest Go features and performance improvements to your App Engine applications. Deploy your services with confidence using this stable and supported runtime.

summary.title: Go 1.26 runtime now in preview
summary.summary: The Go 1.26 runtime is now available in preview for App Engine standard environment. This new runtime offers the latest features and performance improvements for your Go applications.

2026-02-12.content:
Support for deploying your existing apps in the standard environment to Cloud Run using
the `gcloud beta app migrate-to-run` command is in [Preview](https://cloud.google.com/products/#product-launch-stages). For more information, see [Deploy an App Engine app in the standard environment to Cloud Run](https://docs.cloud.google.com/appengine/migration-center/run/migrate-app-engine-standard-to-run).

summary.title: Migrate your apps to Cloud Run
summary.summary: You can now migrate your existing apps in the App Engine standard environment to Cloud Run using the `gcloud beta app migrate-to-run` command. This new feature, currently in Preview, simplifies the deployment process. Find more details on how to migrate your App Engine apps to Cloud Run in the documentation.

2026-01-31.content:
Go 1.11 is [deprecated](https://docs.cloud.google.com/appengine/docs/standard/lifecycle/runtime-lifecycle#deprecated).
You won't be able to deploy Go 1.11 applications, even if your organization
previously used an organization policy to re-enable deployments of legacy
runtimes. Your existing Go 1.11 applications will continue to run and receive
traffic. We recommend that you [migrate to the latest supported version of
Go](https://docs.cloud.google.com/appengine/migration-center/standard/migrate-to-second-gen/go-differences).

summary.title: Go 1.11 runtime deprecated
summary.summary: The Go 1.11 runtime is now deprecated and deployments are no longer permitted. Existing applications will continue to run, but migration to a supported Go version is strongly recommended.

2025-08-07.content: To increase security, starting in March 2025, support for Transport Layer Security (TLS) version 1.1 and earlier is deprecated. [Update your application settings](https://cloud.google.com/appengine/docs/standard/secure-minimum-tls) in the App Engine standard environment to use TLS version 1.2 and later, along with a corresponding secure set of cipher suites (Preview).

summary.title: TLS 1.1 and earlier support deprecated
summary.summary: Secure your applications with TLS 1.2 or later.

2025-07-30.content: Support for [Go 1.25 runtime](https://cloud.google.com/appengine/docs/standard/go/runtime) is in [Preview](https://cloud.google.com/products/#product-launch-stages). This runtime is available for early testers using existing [release candidates](https://go.dev/dl/#unstable).

summary.title: Go 1.24 runtime now in preview
summary.summary: The Go 1.24 runtime is now available in preview for App Engine Standard.
